pr_title: Rewind pooled DHOs into better states
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/10893

Should be tested with https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/4035

The MainCirclePiece/LegacyMainCirclePiece changes are as discussed in Discord. Not sure on adding the new armed state just yet, and this is standard across all other skinning usages/rulesets.

issue_context.title: Rewinding can cause already-hit hitobjects to appear idle
issue_context.body:
Seems to be a regression of pooling. Reproducible in both editor and gameplay by rewinding ~2 seconds back in time.

![2020-11-18_17 13 27](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/99541030-aa8b9c00-29f3-11eb-88c0-1aeb96cc72d9.gif)

review_comments: Not sure about this direction, feels like we are going to be bitten in the ass by using the bindable in similar cases in the future...

Are you able to forego this for the time being since it's a common implementation, and consider an `ArmedState.None` at a later point? There's a lot of things to consider such as how will every ruleset (mods/editor custom states/skinnable components/etc) respond when they receive an `ArmedState.None` event upon `FreeAfterUse()`.

There's a lot of safety checks I want to do when that happens, but I also kinda want to stop working on DHOs and stop breaking changes for a while soon.
yeah, but we should probably add a note somewhere about the behaviour (maybe on State's xmldoc? not sure)
I've added an xmldoc remark on State for now.

wondering whether a null-check here or a cancel of this schedule wouldn't be a good idea - in a theoretical scenario in which the DHO is freed before the schedule executes (e.g. if the DHO never becomes alive) this might fire at some wrong time and die on a nullref, but i'm not sure how theoretical that is
Being a part of the hierarchy in a freed state? That sounds like something that should be asserted instead...
